_note: Static sample triggers. Nothing here is fed to the model as a hint: only `text` is ever sent, as an ordinary chat message from the named person. `expect` is for the people running the take -- it says what this sentence is meant to exercise, so a watcher can tell a correct tier from a lucky one. The agent still assesses severity itself at stage 5 (settled decision 1, docs/workflow.md), so a take where it reads one of these differently is a finding, not a bug in this file.

_tiers.routine: Report to the RP and let them decide. Often covered by a medicine already on file or one plain prescription.
_tiers.urgent: Report to the RP with the detail, and wait. The RP decides whether it moves on.
_tiers.critical: Act first: transport, clinic, family group. Deduct from the wallet, nudge the RP with the amount, and open the reversal window (decision 3).

_how_to_use: Anyone can raise any of these by chatting with the agent. There is no emergency button: the sentence is the trigger.

samples.text: My chest feels heavy and I cannot take anything more than short breaths. It started about twenty minutes ago and it is not easing off.

expect.path: Book the cab, tell the clinic to expect her, status-only line to the family group, deduct the fare, nudge the RP with the amount.

samples.text: I slipped in the bathroom and I cannot get myself up. My hip hurts the moment I put any weight on that leg.

expect.path: She cannot walk to a cab, so this is the ambulance, not a ride. Same four parts, same nudge.

samples.text: Amma's speech has gone slurred in the last half hour and the right side of her face looks like it is drooping. She knows who I am but she cannot finish a sentence.

expect.path: Time-critical and the account is secondhand, so it carries that mark to the doctor (R6). Ambulance, clinic told, group alerted.

samples.text: She is sweating a lot, her hands are shaking and she is barely answering me. She took her tablets this morning but I do not think she has eaten anything since.

expect.path: Touches a current medicine, which is one of the four factors. Transport plus clinic, and the RP is already on the call so the nudge is the spend.

samples.text: Amma rang me saying her chest was tight and then the line cut. I am two hours away and nobody at the house is picking up the phone.

expect.path: Critical with nobody reachable: dispatch anyway, then keep working down the contact list (R9, decision 4). The dispatch is all four parts or it is refused.

samples.text: I have itching all over both my arms and some mild rashness on the skin. It has been like this since yesterday evening.

expect.path: Send the RP the detail and wait. Nothing is booked and nothing is spent until they tap through.

samples.text: I felt dizzy when I stood up this morning and it happened again after lunch. Both times I had to sit back down straight away.

expect.path: Twice in one day is a change from baseline. RP card with both episodes, RP decides.

samples.text: Her ankles have been swollen for three days now and her chappals are not fitting her. She says there is no pain at all.

expect.path: May need a test before anyone can prescribe, so the card says so. The RP decides whether to book it.

samples.text: I checked her BP at home just now and it read 162 over 98. She insists she feels completely fine.

expect.path: A reading, not a symptom. Goes to the RP as a number with the date, never as a conclusion: the agent does not diagnose (R1).

samples.text: I finished the last strip of my daily tablets two days ago and I have not taken any since. Nobody got round to buying more.

expect.path: A must-not-miss medicine already missed. Reorder goes to the RP to confirm, and no substitute is ever offered (R1, R13).

samples.text: I have a normal cough and I have been running a bit of a fever since last night. Nothing else is bothering me.

expect.path: Report to the RP. One plain prescription would cover it, or something already on her shelf. The RP decides, and the agent names no medicine.

samples.text: I get acidity after dinner most nights this week. It settles down if I sit up for a while instead of lying flat.

expect.path: Long-standing and self-settling. RP card, low priority, no booking without their word.

samples.text: Her daily tablets look like they are down to about three days' worth. Can you get them in before they run out this time?

expect.path: Ordinary refill with time in hand. Confirm the order with the RP, and set the next refill clock from what the chemist actually dispenses, never from the prescription (R21).

samples.text: The doctor asked for a routine blood test before her next visit, which is sometime next month. Nothing urgent about it.

expect.path: Book a slot at her convenience once the RP confirms. Cost is below the threshold, so it is a confirm, not an approval.

samples.text: I just do not feel right today. I cannot explain it properly, something feels off and I have been sitting down most of the morning.

expect.path: Nothing here is assessable. The agent must say it cannot tell, which the code raises to urgent and marks as needing a human (R8). Checks that it escalates upward rather than guessing this is nothing.
